purpose: Bounded source note for the IR133 SRF revision, the retained 2025 FD metadata, and BT-coordinate error propagation. This is not a calibration or physical-accuracy approval.

source_distinctions.l1b_calibration_table: The ten 2025-07-19 full-disk AMI files declare calibration_table_version v.3.0_20190415. Their gain, offset, Teff polynomial, and shared constants exactly match the retained v3.0 JSON/workbook table. This establishes the reported BT calibration tuple, not an SRF identifier.
source_distinctions.operational_srf_processing_revision: The KMA-authored 2021 commissioning paper describes selecting a -0.8 cm^-1 IR133 SRF shift by GEO-LEO inter-calibration tests and says the updated SRF entered the operational system on 2019-09-27, with earlier CO2-channel data reprocessed. This is a documented empirical operational SRF-model revision; it is not evidence that the physical sensor response itself changed.
source_distinctions.rttov_srf_package: The NWP-SAF README says KMA supplied updated SRFs and central wavelengths on 2021-02-02, naming the v3.1 IR133-shift workbook and srf.zip. It identifies the channel-16 file New_AMI_SRF_IR133_-0.80wn.txt and center 752.792 cm^-1. The currently installed RTTOV coefficient row uses 752.7924878 cm^-1.
source_distinctions.unresolved_product_compatibility: The 2025 FD files have no SRF or explicit BT-wavenumber metadata. Their v3.0 calibration-table label cannot identify which SRF processing model was used. The KO files are remapped ELA products and do not expose source-FD lineage or a calibration/SRF version. Therefore the actual 2025 observation SRF epoch is unverified.

official_sources.title: NWP-SAF GKOMPSAT-2 AMI SRF README
official_sources.facts: Generated 2021-05-04; README dated 2021-04-27. States updated SRFs and central wavelengths were received from KMA on 2021-02-02; lists the v3.1 shifted workbook, v3.1 channel centers, and New_AMI_SRF_IR133_-0.80wn.txt for channel 16.

official_sources.title: Kim et al., Introduction of the Advanced Meteorological Imager of Geo-Kompsat-2a: In-Orbit Tests and Performance Validation, Remote Sensing 13(7), 1303 (2021)
official_sources.facts: Reports generating IR133 SRFs at 0.1 cm^-1 shift increments from -1 to +1, applying them through the ground processing algorithm, and comparing updated L1B against IASI-B with GSICS for 2019-07-23 through 2019-08-11. The -0.8 cm^-1 case minimized the reported bias; the paper says it was implemented operationally on 2019-09-27 and prior CO2 observations were reprocessed. This identifies an empirical processing-model choice and date, not the SRF identity of each 2025 product.

retained_2025_fd_metadata.source_manifest: NOAA GK2A PDS AMI/L1B/FD/202507/19/00; manifest sizes match local original files

why_bt_conversion_does_not_replace_an_sr.discrete_counterexample: Take two spectral bins and response A=(1,0), response B=(0,1). Spectra x=(1,1) and x'=(1,2) both give A(x)=A(x')=1, while B(x)=1 and B(x')=2. Any scalar g(A) returns the same value for both spectra and therefore cannot reproduce B for both. This demonstrates the general limitation for distinct non-proportional response functions; it is not a numerical comparison of the unavailable original IR133 curve.
why_bt_conversion_does_not_replace_an_sr.scope: Planck/brightness-temperature coordinate conversion maps a band radiance to a temperature convention. It cannot reconstruct information about spectral radiance variation that a different band response would weight differently. Actual IR133 spectral error remains unmeasured here.

error_coordinate_policy.mapping: For per-channel maps y_R=Psi(L) and y_K=Phi(L), define f=Phi composed with inverse(Psi), and D=diag(f'(y_R)) locally.
error_coordinate_policy.covariance: For small perturbations, R_K approximately D R_R D^T (first-order delta method); the local bias transforms approximately as b_K approximately D b_R. Nonlinear curvature can add higher-order mean effects.
error_coordinate_policy.not_an_error_estimate: The 5.7 K model-observation residual is not an observation standard deviation or covariance. The current 1 K diagonal (`obs_sigma` default in oracle/kdm6/da_driver.py) is a code default, not an approved calibrated observation-error assignment. Instrument NEdT or calibration-accuracy specifications are not, by themselves, cloudy-scene representativeness/error covariance.
